name: Ava Bernal
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I missed my wedding anniversary after swapping two entries in a calendar.” Friday often includes a stop at Lighthouse Cove, where Ava takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: I was about to accuse a new volunteer when my own scribble turned up on the tin.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a moss-green cardigan and a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve. Ava has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with short copper curls. Ava steadies a cup with both hands while listening during a conversation.
personality: Ava enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To clear the new volunteer's name face to face.
family: Sadie Carver is Ava’s half-sibling. Ava asks before bringing somebody along. Sadie can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The salon on strike*, Sadie says, “I work under a name my family doesn't know.”
connections: Nolan Costa (key identifier). Touch identifies the keys the coordinator was ready to declare missing.

reactions.response: Ava checks the returned tins before letting a name go into the complaint.
